preconditions: Same mapped contact fitted at three or more unique spatial radii
Explicit section azimuth and diagnostic thresholds
decisionLogic: Require normal separation, apparent-dip spread and orthogonal RMSE all within declared thresholds
uncertainty: Thresholds are project diagnostics and must not be presented as observed geological accuracy
exclusions: A stable map/DEM fit alone does not authorize subsurface continuation
Axial normals ignore arbitrary normal sign
validationMethod: Stable, direction-reversal, mixed-feature and repeated-radius tests
reopenCondition: Direct structural observations or evidence-backed thresholds become available
